I am currently very satisfied with the care it provides.
It has improved in recent years in two ways.
First, online contact, via its website and the PATCHS system, has transformed my ability to get timely appointments, responses to queries and the general level of communication.
Secondly, it seems that staff changes to the running of the reception desk and administration have improved efficiency and approachability.
The latter was necessary. I know from my own experience and that of others that in the past it had led to mistakes, frustration and even to people transferring from the practice.
As a result I am happy to recommend it strongly.
One does not always get face-to-face appointments, consultations with GPs as opposed to other medical professionals, and not routinely with the same GP. This does not unduly bother me, although a return to seeing the same GP who knows my history would be welcome.
The online contact is good and developing. However, I have found it difficult, both via PATCHS and the website, to navigate to the relevant page if I am looking to make a non-urgent enquiry rather than an urgent appointment. I managed to get a Saturday appointment once because my Mum phoned (yes, I'm an adult but I was so upset after being told I had to wait, yet again, a month for an appointment, when I was poorly, I couldn't deal with it myself). GP was great when I met with them but follow up has been poor. I had tests which I've had no feedback on, and when I submitted a request to discuss results I was told to look online. There were no results to look at online, so I'm waiting for my appointment to discuss. I have been waiting a month for this appointment. Hope it isn't cancelled!

I had such a good GP when I lived in the city centre and I'm so upset with the service at this practice. I have ongoing issues and I feel like I'm having to manage it myself.
